body.statement: Set \(p=3\) and fix the ordered embedding \(\iota(X)=i_X=1\), \(\iota(Y)=i_Y=2\), and \(\iota(Z)=i_Z=3\). For each type \(r\) in the fixed synthetic protocol, the truncated-factorization contrasts satisfy \(\tau_{i_Y,r}=3\) and \(\tau_{i_Z,r}=25\).
body.justification: This checks the designated-coordinate intervention arithmetic in the synthetic three-node application.
body.gap: The calculation is an application check and is not presented as a theorem-level novelty claim.
body.consumer: It supplies auditable contrast targets for the finite-input certificate without treating the synthetic box as biological calibration.
